newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate delays voting after Geisel's death.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate delays voting after Geisel's death.

text.p: The Brazilian Senate temporarily halted Thursday's voting session to honour former military president Ernesto Geisel, who died in the morning aged 88.

Votes on a bill exempting exports from the so-called ICMS tax and on a bill allowing the Central Bank to restructure its Brady bond portfolio would resume after senators' speeches in remembrance of Geisel, Senate President Jose Sarney said.
